description: `prose --output json share` prints the INVOCATION_INVALID envelope whose suggestedArgv is `cli run share --help`, and the Action says the link is public and `cli org invite` gives one person access.

problem.action: `cli run share` makes a public, unrevocable 24-hour link; `cli org invite` gives one person access. Use `cli run share RUN_ID --preview`; `prose --output json cli run share --help` shows its arguments.

details.reason: `share` is not a command; did you mean `prose --output json cli run share --help`? `cli run share RUN_ID` mints a public, unrevocable 24-hour link to a run's artifacts; `cli org invite` gives one person access. Nothing was forwarded or sent. To pass these words to the OpenProse language instead, put `--` before them
